scope: every PPTX creation, import beautification, theme, visual-upgrade, and material-generation path
semantic_scope: open_vocabulary; no fixed topic or scene list; multilingual source-grounded objects, people, actions, places, and services

behavior.abstract_and_data_scene_rule: Before NO_SCENE, consider a clearly relevant representative real-world scene for the source topic even when the text contains only abstract concepts or metrics; do not force unrelated imagery, and require a page-specific reason when no safe and non-misleading representative scene exists.
behavior.empty_scene_plan_reconsideration: When the complete source-grounded plan has zero scenes and a complete first audit returns NO_GAPS, allow exactly one same-model reconsideration over all original-language pages. If it proposes scenes, require a third complete-deck audit; if it remains empty, the scene gate still blocks generation. Never fabricate scenes or photos.
behavior.image_truthfulness: Every stock-photo scene is illustrative, not proof of a specific person, company, event, metric or outcome. Exact source excerpts ground the topic; an original-language illustration rationale states the semantic connection and is stored with image attribution in alt text and notes.
behavior.photo_attribution: CC BY 4.0 images require creator/attribution, source URL, canonical license URL, and a note describing any crop or pixel edit; Pexels results require a visible Pexels provider link, photographer credit when available, source URL, Pexels license URL, and no standalone asset redistribution; records are stored in image alternative text and slide speaker notes.
behavior.photo_search_prompt_boundary: For licensed-photo search, only short neutral-English primary or reformulated visual queries are sent to the provider; source excerpts, slide text and metrics remain local. Pexels is opt-in and receives requests only when PEXELS_API_KEY is configured. Every returned asset is gated against the original structured subject/action/setting anchors. A negative prompt is not treated as a photo-search filter.
behavior.photo_framing: Use source image dimensions to choose a safe placement; fully contain photos in empty areas without cropping. A planned visual replacement slot may use cover crop only when its aspect ratio differs by no more than the configured factor; otherwise block and request a new layout.

behavior.examples_note: 以上中英文示例仅说明语义场景规划范围，是非穷尽示例；其他由稿件语义支持的题材同样适用。 These bilingual examples illustrate scope and do not define an exhaustive taxonomy.
behavior.multilingual_policy: 用户材料可以是主流语言或混合语言。离线检测只提供语言提示，不能把未知/混合判断当作拒绝理由；本机模型必须读取原文，场景描述保持来源页语言，原文证据逐字保留，向图库仅发送中性英文场景查询。跨语言补漏只有在同一稳定 canonical_scene_id 且每个页面均有可信、不同的语言提示时才可暂时复用原场景；第三轮全稿语义复核仍必须确认等价并排除不同子场景合并。未知/混合语言或身份不确定时失败关闭，不自动合并。无法理解、证据不匹配或找不到合规图片时阻断，不臆造或回退文字卡片。
behavior.provider_tls_failure_handling: Only explicit HTTPS/TLS handshake timeouts use a job-local breaker: stop remaining synonym attempts for that provider, skip that search provider for the rest of the same job, and continue once through each other configured provider. For image-file CDN handshakes, skip only the failed host for that job. Generic timeouts do not trip either breaker. No image is fabricated and the semantic scene gate remains fail-closed.

confident per-page language hints for cross-language scene reuse, with identical canonical_scene_id and post-repair semantic verification

scene_visual_plan.json canonical SHA256 and the complete neutral visual query
Pexels configured-state evidence without recording the API key value
provider, source page, creator, license, and image byte SHA256 for every accepted photo
candidate PPTX picture marker, actual embedded image SHA256, 128-bit dHash+aHash, page, and area

validation status in required checks coverage
